description: Home connectivity at a glance: AT&T gateway, home nodes, and how metrics are buffered through outages.

panels.description: Both home nodes report Ready to the API server in OVH. Computed by kube-state-metrics in OVH, so this goes Down live during a home outage, unlike the series scraped at home.
panels.title: Home seen from OVH

panels.description: The gateway's WAN link (broadband status page).
panels.title: WAN

panels.description: The gateway's optical link (fiber status page).
panels.title: Fiber

panels.description: Time since the gateway last booted.
panels.title: Gateway uptime

panels.description: Times the gateway's uptime went back to zero in the last 7 days.
panels.title: Gateway reboots (7d)

panels.description: Largest delay between the newest sample a home Alloy has collected and the newest it has delivered to Mimir. Grows while home is cut off, drains after it reconnects.
panels.title: Home metrics backlog

targets.expr: max(max by (node) (clamp_min(max by (pod) (prometheus_remote_storage_highest_timestamp_in_seconds{job="alloy-node"}) - max by (pod) (prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_sent_timestamp_seconds{job="alloy-node"}), 0) * on (pod) group_left (node) max by (pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",created_by_name="alloy-node",node=~"wyrm2|optiplex"})))

panels.description: Each row is one link or node over time. A blank stretch means Mimir has no samples for it: home was unreachable and the data was not (or not yet) replayed from a home buffer. The OVH-side Ready rows go Down during an outage; the rows scraped at home show what home itself saw once their buffer is replayed.
panels.title: Home connectivity timeline

panels.description: Traffic through the gateway's WAN port.
panels.title: Internet throughput (gateway WAN)

panels.description: Traffic on each home node's Nebula interface, which carries all of its cluster traffic to OVH, including metrics remote-write.
panels.title: Home to OVH tunnel (Nebula)

panels.description: Optical power the gateway receives from the fiber, against the gateway's own warning and alarm bounds. A slow drift toward the low bound points at the fiber or a connector.
panels.title: Fiber Rx power

panels.description: Optical power the gateway transmits, against its warning and alarm bounds.
panels.title: Fiber Tx power

panels.description: Temperature of the gateway's optical module, against its warning and alarm bounds.
panels.title: Optics temperature

panels.description: Errors and drops on the gateway's WAN interface, per 5 minutes.
panels.title: Gateway WAN errors and drops

panels.description: Errors and drops on each gateway LAN port, per 5 minutes. Port 1 is the uplink to the home switch.
panels.title: Gateway LAN port errors and drops

panels.description: Link state of each gateway LAN port. Port 1 is the uplink to the home switch.
panels.title: Gateway LAN ports

panels.description: Leases the gateway has handed out, and how many it has left.
panels.title: Gateway DHCP leases

panels.description: Entries in the gateway's NAT session table against its capacity. A full table drops new connections.
panels.title: Gateway NAT sessions

panels.description: Result of the gateway's latest successful speed test to AT&T, protocol overhead included.
panels.title: Speed test throughput

panels.description: Average round-trip latency during the latest successful speed test.
panels.title: Speed test latency

panels.description: When the latest successful speed test in each direction completed.
panels.title: Speed test ran

panels.description: The switch answers the exporter's API queries. mktxp keeps serving its own metrics while the switch is unreachable, so this checks for switch data rather than the scrape.
panels.title: Switch reachable

panels.description: Time since the switch last booted.
panels.title: Switch uptime

panels.description: Traffic on each switch port, as the switch counts it.
panels.title: Switch port traffic

panels.description: Receive and transmit errors plus drops on each switch port, per 5 minutes.
panels.title: Switch port errors and drops

targets.expr: max by (name) (increase(mktxp_interface_rx_error_total{routerboard_name="CRS310",name=~"ether.*|sfp.*"}[5m])) + max by (name) (increase(mktxp_interface_rx_drop_total{routerboard_name="CRS310",name=~"ether.*|sfp.*"}[5m])) + max by (name) (increase(mktxp_interface_tx_error_total{routerboard_name="CRS310",name=~"ether.*|sfp.*"}[5m])) + max by (name) (increase(mktxp_interface_tx_drop_total{routerboard_name="CRS310",name=~"ether.*|sfp.*"}[5m]))

panels.description: Times each switch port's link went down, per hour.
panels.title: Switch port link flaps

panels.description: Link state of each switch port.
panels.title: Switch port links

panels.description: Temperatures the switch reports.
panels.title: Switch temperatures

panels.description: The switch's own log, sent by syslog.
panels.title: Switch log

panels.description: Traffic on each home node's physical NIC.
panels.title: Home node LAN throughput

panels.description: Receive and transmit errors plus drops on each home node's physical NIC, per 5 minutes.
panels.title: Home node NIC errors and drops

targets.expr: sum by (instance, device) (increase(node_network_receive_errs_total{job="node-exporter",device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[5m])+increase(node_network_transmit_errs_total{job="node-exporter",device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[5m])+increase(node_network_receive_drop_total{job="node-exporter",device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[5m])+increase(node_network_transmit_drop_total{job="node-exporter",device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[5m])) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"wyrm2|optiplex"})

panels.description: Carrier changes (cable or switch port going down and up) on each home node's physical NIC, per hour.
panels.title: Home node NIC link flaps

panels.description: How far each home Alloy's delivered data trails what it has collected. It is reported by the Alloy itself, so an outage shows up here only once its backlog is replayed.
panels.title: Remote-write delay per home node

targets.expr: max by (node) (clamp_min(max by (pod) (prometheus_remote_storage_highest_timestamp_in_seconds{job="alloy-node"}) - max by (pod) (prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_sent_timestamp_seconds{job="alloy-node"}), 0) * on (pod) group_left (node) max by (pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",created_by_name="alloy-node",node=~"wyrm2|optiplex"}))

panels.description: Samples each home Alloy holds in its send queue.
panels.title: Samples waiting to send

targets.expr: max by (node) (max by (pod) (prometheus_remote_storage_samples_pending{job="alloy-node"}) * on (pod) group_left (node) max by (pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",created_by_name="alloy-node",node=~"wyrm2|optiplex"}))

panels.description: Active series in each home Alloy's write-ahead log.
panels.title: Series in WAL

targets.expr: max by (node) (max by (pod) (prometheus_remote_write_wal_storage_active_series{job="alloy-node"}) * on (pod) group_left (node) max by (pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",created_by_name="alloy-node",node=~"wyrm2|optiplex"}))
